checks.name: self-contained-no-sdk-no-external-asset-no-secret-path
checks.summary: JS SYNTAX OK (host node v24.18.0, syntax check only, no execution and no browser). node is not in the devbox --pure environment, so this one check was run with the host node and is recorded as such. The appended block is an IIFE that uses only fetch against this origin's own relative path /v1/release/state, document.getElementById, document.createElement and textContent. It loads no provider SDK, no external asset, no remote font and no remote script, starts no timer and no poll loop, and reads no credential-bearing field. Every value rendered comes from the response; a field the response does not carry is rendered as an explicit 'unreported' or 'no reason was reported' string rather than as a plausible value, and a 503 is rendered as the API's own message.

checks.name: tri-state-is-rendered-as-three-states
checks.summary: the console lists only the conditions whose state is not met, each with its contract text, its reason, the sources that decided it and every refusal as its own kind, plus the release version and bundle digest, the assembly instant, the environment class, the promotable flag, the rollback target with rollback availability, the not_observed list and the residual gaps. The state is mapped explicitly: met, not-observable-here, and anything else as blocked, so a not-observable-here condition is never displayed as met and an unknown future state fails visible rather than silently green.
